android.jdk: OpenJDK17 bundled with exact Unity editor installation; do not substitute Android Studio JBR
android.jdk_patch_policy: Use editor-bundled binary as exact upstream selection; capture java -version and SHA256 at PH01. No invented patch number.
android.signing: Debug key for local/test only; owner-controlled upload key and Play App Signing for production

unity_package_policy: Editor-core packages are selected by editor version rather than fabricated independent patch numbers. Commit actual packages-lock.json and hashes at PH01; no latest, caret, or automatic upgrade policy for top-level selectable packages.

advertising.resolver: one shared EDM4U1.2.189; remove duplicate older resolver

purchases.telemetry_review: Explicitly configure Unity Developer Data/consent; IAP package telemetry is included in SDK inventory. Never assume Firebase is the only telemetry source.

backend.language: JavaScript ESM; Node built-in test runner; no TypeScript compiler dependency
backend.database: Firestore Native; no client database access
backend.reporting_region: EU BigQuery dataset where supported; verify all provider data handling separately
backend.runtime_version_note: Managed service patch levels and remote service binaries cannot be made permanently immutable by a design document; capture deployed revision and resolved npm lock at integration.

conflict_rule: Fail PH01/PH05 with a precise reproduction; Director issues a versioned T002 amendment, not an undocumented local upgrade.

phase_policy.PH01: Unity, Android, Input System, Newtonsoft and editor-core UI/test packages only; no real commercial SDK initialization
phase_policy.PH05: Selected Firebase, Ads/UMP, IAP and backend integrations plus exact resolved dependency and consent proof

verification_note: Rechecked selected primary version references during consolidation; live joint build proof remains NOT_BUILT. No silent latest-version replacement.
